patterns.note: Sections are presented as full-width blocks with generous vertical spacing, creating a clean, airy feel and emphasizing individual content modules.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, providing strong visual hierarchy, often paired with smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.

The primary color scheme is monochrome (black and white), serving as a neutral canvas that allows vibrant, project-specific accent colors (e.g., purple, blue, pink) to stand out dramatically within their respective sections.
Content sections are revealed with a smooth, staggered fade-in and subtle upward slide animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging content flow.
Project showcases frequently utilize a two-column grid layout for displaying high-quality images or video stills, often with minimal accompanying text.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom smooth scrolling experience, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll, which provides a fluid, physics-based scroll feel rather than standard browser scrolling.
Sections are animated into view using scroll-triggered reveals, where elements within a section fade in and translate slightly upwards as the section enters the user's viewport, enhancing engagement.
Hero sections and specific project showcases integrate dynamic media, such as video backgrounds or WebGL-rendered graphics, to create immersive and visually rich experiences.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels, creating a strong, modern contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (elements feature minimal to no rounded corners, maintaining a crisp, precise aesthetic).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal padding throughout, especially between sections and around text blocks, contributing to a premium, uncluttered feel).

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its sophisticated, art-gallery-like presentation of work, blending high-quality, full-bleed imagery and video with a minimalist, monochrome aesthetic. The seamless, scroll-driven content reveals and dynamic project showcases create an immersive and premium user experience that feels more like an interactive portfolio than a typical agency site.
